title: MemoryImportsStageRequest
description: Stage one export chunk, in strict ordinal order; accumulation is durable across provider crashes and staged data stays invisible to non-transfer ops. Out-of-order chunks fail INVALID_INPUT. Final-chunk verification failures reject IMPORT_CONFLICT with details.errors[] and stage nothing. Grant: transfer plus admin on the target space. Mutating op: requires idempotency_key (§7.0.5) and returns a MemoryReceipt whose result is a content-free summary (§7.0.2).

chunk.description: Export chunk being staged (decision D8 header/extension shape preserved).

conflict_policy.description: Required iff chunk.chunk_ordinal = 0; MUST be omitted otherwise.

adopt_grants.description: Chunk 0 only. Only listed grants are created on the target and only when the staging principal coverage subsumes them; unlisted grants are dropped and none is auto-activated (MEM-R025).

idempotency_key.description: Caller-chosen, 1–128 characters (§6.1); unique within the dedup namespace (space_id, requester_principal_id, op, idempotency_key) (§7.0.5).
